Bid Award Panel grant authority to award the contract in accordance with the Contract Details set out in the report ( July 6, 2023) from the Chief Procurement Officer: Solicitation Number: Request for Quotation, Ariba Document Number 3743035784 Description: For the non-exclusive supply, delivery, installation, warranty of all materials, equipment, engineering and supervisor to perform inspection, examination, testing, maintenance and repairs, and issue certification for lifting devices, for a period of one (1) year from the date of award, with the option to renew the contracts for four (4) additional separate one (1) year periods. Should the option(s) be exercised, then the General Manager of Toronto Water Division, will request the Chief Procurement Officer to process the renewals under the same terms and conditions.
